up: Find all molecule records linked to the document with chembl_id CHEMBL5728081. Return: md.molregno (molecule internal ID), md.chembl_id (public ChEMBL identifier), md.pref_name (preferred molecule name), d.doc_id (document identifier), d.title (document title), d.doc_type (document type), d.journal (journal name), and d.year (publication year). Optionally also return the compound's canonical SMILES. Ensure the molecule is associated with the specified document via its compound_records association (compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id). Do not filter further on doc_type, DOI, or activity data. Present results without duplicates, sorted by molecule identifier.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.molregno, md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, d.doc_id, d.title, d.doc_type, d.journal, d.year, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM molecule_dictionary md
JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno
JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE cr.doc_id IN (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728081')
ORDER BY md.molregno;
